name: tunakula
description: Tunakula — multi-country, multi-currency food ordering and delivery platform on NZELA-OS

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.guard: node tools/guard-core.ts && node tools/guard-boundaries.ts && node tools/guard-brand.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @tunakula/web-customer && npm run build -w @tunakula/web-admin
scripts.check:shared: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run test:shared
scripts.check:backend: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:api
scripts.check:frontend: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run guard && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run check:shared && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
